stability_rules: required export names remain stable within stdlib major version 1
result tag numeric identity remains stable within stdlib major version 1
text/data helper meaning remains count-and-presence preserving within stdlib major version 1
helpers may grow additively, but exported families must not move between modules without updating the checked-in contracts
advanced helper family ownership remains tied to objc3.concurrency objc3.keypath and objc3.system within stdlib major version 1
strict-system helper exposure remains profile-gated and must not be widened into core claims without a checked-in contract update

core_semantics.runtime_core_abi: objc3.core helpers route through objc3_runtime_stdlib_core_* entrypoints and publish runtime-owned call evidence through objc3_runtime_copy_stdlib_core_state_for_testing
core_semantics.capability_query_encoding: known Core-profile stdlib capability ordinals 1 through 4 are present; strict-system ordinal 5, zero, negative, and unknown positive ids fail closed as missing
core_semantics.option_unwrap_or: routes through objc3_runtime_stdlib_core_option_unwrap_or_i32 and returns value when presence flag is nonzero, otherwise the caller-supplied default
core_semantics.string_view_length: routes through objc3_runtime_stdlib_core_count_i32 and applies a zero floor to negative unit counts
core_semantics.string_view_prefix_units: routes through objc3_runtime_stdlib_core_prefix_count_i32 and clamps both count and requested units to a zero floor
core_semantics.byte_span_length: routes through objc3_runtime_stdlib_core_count_i32 and applies a zero floor to negative byte counts
core_semantics.byte_span_prefix_length: routes through objc3_runtime_stdlib_core_prefix_count_i32 and clamps both count and requested units to a zero floor
core_semantics.array_count: routes through objc3_runtime_stdlib_core_count_i32 and applies a zero floor to negative element counts
core_semantics.array_prefix_count: routes through objc3_runtime_stdlib_core_prefix_count_i32 and clamps both count and requested elements to a zero floor
core_semantics.map_entry_value_or: routes through objc3_runtime_stdlib_core_map_entry_value_or_i32 and returns value when presence flag is nonzero, otherwise the caller-supplied default

error_semantics.result_is_ok: returns 1 only when tag equals result_ok_tag
error_semantics.option_to_result_tag: maps nonzero presence to result_ok_tag and zero presence to result_err_tag
error_semantics.option_result_shape_diagnostic: returns 0 when option presence matches the provided result tag, otherwise 30601
error_semantics.result_unwrap_or: returns value only when tag equals result_ok_tag, otherwise the caller-supplied default
error_semantics.result_error_or: returns code only when tag equals result_err_tag, otherwise the caller-supplied default
error_semantics.ok_or_code: returns value when nonzero, otherwise the caller-supplied default
error_semantics.or_throw_code: returns value when nonzero, otherwise the caller-supplied default
error_semantics.text_data_shape_diagnostic: returns 0 when unit_count equals byte_count, otherwise 30602

text_semantics.utf8_literal_record: routes compiler-lowered UTF-8 literal metadata through objc3_runtime_stdlib_text_utf8_literal_i32 and returns a runtime-owned handle only for nonnegative byte/unit counts with units not greater than bytes and a nonzero valid-UTF8 flag
text_semantics.byte_count: routes through objc3_runtime_stdlib_text_byte_count_i32 and returns 0 plus invalid-handle status for unknown handles
text_semantics.unit_count: routes through objc3_runtime_stdlib_text_unit_count_i32 and returns 0 plus invalid-handle status for unknown handles
text_semantics.valid_utf8: routes through objc3_runtime_stdlib_text_is_valid_utf8_i32 and returns 1 only for valid runtime-owned text records
text_semantics.prefix_units: routes through objc3_runtime_stdlib_text_prefix_units_i32 and clamps requested units to the runtime-owned text unit count with a zero floor
text_semantics.concat: routes through objc3_runtime_stdlib_text_concat_i32 and creates a runtime-owned record whose byte and unit counts are the checked sums of both operands

collection_semantics.array3_record: routes concrete i32 array construction through objc3_runtime_stdlib_collections_array3_i32 and returns a runtime-owned handle only for counts from 0 through 3
collection_semantics.array_count: routes through objc3_runtime_stdlib_collections_array_count_i32 and returns 0 plus invalid-handle status for unknown handles
collection_semantics.array_get_or: routes through objc3_runtime_stdlib_collections_array_get_or_i32 and returns the caller default while recording out-of-bounds status for invalid indexes
collection_semantics.array_prefix_count: routes through objc3_runtime_stdlib_collections_array_prefix_count_i32 and clamps requested elements to the runtime-owned array count with a zero floor
collection_semantics.map_entry: routes single-entry i32 map construction through objc3_runtime_stdlib_collections_map_entry_i32 and returns a runtime-owned handle
collection_semantics.map_lookup_or: routes through objc3_runtime_stdlib_collections_map_lookup_or_i32 and returns the caller default while recording not-found status for missing keys
collection_semantics.array_slice: routes concrete i32 array slicing through objc3_runtime_stdlib_collections_array_slice_i32 and returns a runtime-owned slice handle only for ranges inside the source array
collection_semantics.array_iterator: routes concrete i32 array iteration through objc3_runtime_stdlib_collections_array_iterator_i32 and objc3_runtime_stdlib_collections_iterator_next_or_i32 with insertion-order values followed by an explicit iteration-end status
collection_semantics.slice_get_or: routes concrete i32 slice indexing through objc3_runtime_stdlib_collections_slice_get_or_i32 and returns the caller default while recording out-of-bounds status for invalid slice indexes
collection_semantics.slice_iterator: routes concrete i32 slice iteration through objc3_runtime_stdlib_collections_slice_iterator_i32 and objc3_runtime_stdlib_collections_iterator_next_or_i32 with view-order values followed by an explicit iteration-end status
collection_semantics.set3_record: routes concrete i32 set construction through objc3_runtime_stdlib_collections_set3_i32, deduplicates values in insertion order, and returns a runtime-owned handle only for counts from 0 through 3
collection_semantics.set_contains: routes through objc3_runtime_stdlib_collections_set_contains_i32 and records not-found status for missing values
collection_semantics.set_insert: routes through objc3_runtime_stdlib_collections_set_insert_i32, mutates the runtime-owned set only for new values, and increments the version observed by fail-closed iterators
collection_semantics.set_iterator: routes concrete i32 set iteration through objc3_runtime_stdlib_collections_set_iterator_i32 and fails closed with mutated-during-iteration status when the set version changes before iterator completion

keypath_semantics.component_count: returns root plus offset as the explicit component-count shape
keypath_semantics.text_shape_score: returns component_count plus text_units for canonical text-shape validation
keypath_semantics.text_shape_diagnostic: returns 0 when text_units is at least component_count, otherwise 30603
keypath_semantics.typed_keypath_metadata: preserves root and component counts as the current metadata token shape
keypath_semantics.reflection_interop: must preserve the caller-visible keypath component count and diagnostic behavior across module boundaries
keypath_semantics.runtime_composition_shape: must preserve explicit component counts without inventing ownership or allocation semantics
keypath_semantics.reflection_interop_token: returns component_count when reflected_components is negative, otherwise component_count plus reflected_components
keypath_semantics.runtime_composition_token: returns component_count when imported_components is negative, otherwise component_count plus imported_components

concurrency_semantics.spawn_token: routes structured spawn through objc3_runtime_spawn_task_i32 with task kind 1 and the caller-provided executor tag
concurrency_semantics.child_spawn_token: routes structured child spawn through objc3_runtime_spawn_task_i32 with task kind 1 and the caller-provided executor tag
concurrency_semantics.detached_spawn_token: routes detached spawn through objc3_runtime_spawn_task_i32 with task kind 2 and the caller-provided executor tag
concurrency_semantics.join_status: routes cancellation through objc3_runtime_task_on_cancel_i32 on the supplied executor and non-cancelled completion through objc3_runtime_executor_hop_i32 with the supplied result value and executor tag
concurrency_semantics.task_group_scope_depth: routes scope entry, one FIFO task addition and wait per requested child task through the runtime task-group helper cluster; invalid child counts fail closed through objc3_runtime_cancel_task_group_i32
concurrency_semantics.cancellation_checkpoint: routes cancellation checkpoints through objc3_runtime_cancel_task_group_i32 when flagged and objc3_runtime_task_is_cancelled_i32 otherwise
concurrency_semantics.executor_hop_token: routes executor hops through objc3_runtime_executor_hop_i32 with distinct value and executor-tag operands
concurrency_semantics.actor_mailbox_token: routes actor mailbox binding, enqueue, and drain behavior through the runtime actor mailbox helper cluster with distinct actor-handle and executor-tag operands
concurrency_semantics.family_growth_rule: structured-child-spawn detached-spawn join-and-wait task-group-scope cancellation-observation executor-hop actor-mailbox public-task-spawn public-task-join public-task-group public-cancellation public-executor-hop and public-actor-mailbox helpers may grow additively inside objc3.concurrency
concurrency_semantics.layering_rule: objc3.concurrency may depend only on objc3.core and objc3.errors within stdlib major version 1
concurrency_semantics.public_task_spawn_api: objc3_task_spawn, objc3_task_spawn_child, and objc3_task_spawn_detached are stable public aliases over the structured and detached runtime task spawn helpers
concurrency_semantics.public_task_join_api: objc3_task_join routes non-cancelled public task joins through objc3_concurrency_join_status and preserves explicit result and executor-tag operands
concurrency_semantics.public_task_group_api: objc3_task_group_run_two enters a task-group scope, adds two child tasks, and drains them through objc3_concurrency_task_group_scope_depth
concurrency_semantics.public_cancellation_api: objc3_task_is_cancelled and objc3_task_cancel_if_needed expose cancellation observation and cancellation checkpoints without widening scheduler policy claims
concurrency_semantics.public_executor_api: objc3_executor_hop is the public executor-hop entrypoint over objc3_concurrency_executor_hop_token with distinct value and executor-tag operands
concurrency_semantics.public_actor_mailbox_api: objc3_actor_mailbox_send_and_drain binds, enqueues, and drains a single actor mailbox message through objc3_concurrency_actor_mailbox_token

system_semantics.resource_token: returns seed plus 4 as the canonical deterministic strict-system resource token
system_semantics.cleanup_token: returns seed plus 4 plus cleanup_count when cleanup_count is nonnegative, otherwise seed plus 4
system_semantics.lifetime_borrow_token: returns seed plus 4 plus borrow_depth when borrow_depth is nonnegative, otherwise seed plus 4
system_semantics.diagnostics_gate_token: returns 30704 when observed_profile is lower than required_profile and 0 otherwise
system_semantics.profile_gate: objc3.system helpers remain gated to Strict System and must not become unconditional Core imports
system_semantics.runtime_composition_hook: strict-system runtime-composition helpers must be explicit profile-gated entrypoints rather than implicit side effects in core helpers
system_semantics.layering_rule: objc3.system may depend on objc3.core objc3.errors objc3.concurrency and objc3.keypath but those modules may not depend on objc3.system

non_goals: Foundation NSString NSArray NSDictionary or NSData compatibility promises
presenting runtime-backed executor or reflection semantics without checked-in helper exports
widening strict-system helpers into always-on core imports
